name: Lexware Office
description: Invoices and credit notes in Lexware Office for your orders

images.title: Paid orders, invoiced in Lexware
images.description: An invoice is created in Lexware Office when an order is paid, and a credit note when it is refunded.

images.title: Every document, on its order
images.description: Each order shows its invoice and credit notes, with the Lexware number, the PDF and a link into Lexware.

images.title: Exact to the cent
images.description: The invoice total is what the customer paid, with the right Lexware tax type for Germany, the EU and exports.

images.title: Nothing lost quietly
images.description: What Lexware refuses is listed with the reason. Correct the cause and retry, one by one or all at once.

images.title: Set up in a minute
images.description: Paste your Lexware API key, test the connection, and start with drafts until you are ready.
